name: Arteja
source:
The events take place in the fantasy world of Nanraas. The main characters are annors - cute creatures that look like upright cats. The peculiarity of this species is the ability to control psio-energy and the presence of organic crystals in their biology. They say that it is in them that the soul and personality of each annor is preserved. That is why scientists have been studying their features for many years, and it seems that the answers to the desired questions are close at hand.

Arteya Longrans is a talented scientist who works on a promising project to create paw-shaped crystals, which are as close as possible to organic annor crystals in terms of properties. If successful, the research should forever change the world for the better and open a new branch of the race's development. However, something tragic happens that changes the lives of Arteya and her loved ones forever. Now she will have to go through the difficult path of changing herself to correct the mistakes of the past. At least partially.

[Translated from [url=https://telleryspyro-gtx.itch.io/arteya]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这些事件发生在南拉斯的奇幻世界中。主角是安诺尔——一种看起来像直立的猫的可爱生物。该物种的独特之处在于控制灵能的能力以及其生物学中有机晶体的存在。他们说，正是在他们身上，每个安诺尔的灵魂和个性得以保存。这就是为什么科学家们多年来一直在研究它们的特征，而且似乎想要的问题的答案就在眼前。

Arteya Longrans是一位才华横溢的科学家，她致力于一项前景广阔的项目，即制造爪形晶体，这种晶体在特性方面与有机安诺晶体尽可能接近。如果成功，这项研究将永远改变世界，让世界变得更好，并为种族的发展开辟新的分支。然而，悲惨的事情发生了，永远改变了阿尔特亚和她所爱之人的生活。现在，她将不得不经历改变自己的艰难道路，以纠正过去的错误。至少部分如此。

[译自[url=https://telleryspyro-gtx.itch.io/arteya]itch.io[/url]]
